newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia approves free-trade zone in Rijeka port.
newsitem.headline: Croatia approves free-trade zone in Rijeka port.

text.p: The Croatian government decided on Thursday to approve the setting up of a free-trade zone in the Adriatic port of Rijeka, state news agency HINA reported.

The Rijeka port administration will be allowed to establish the free-trade zone, determine its boundaries and the scope of its activities and secure means for its work, the government said in a statement carried by HINA.
The agency provided no other details.
Croatia on Monday signed agreements to establish two free-trade zones near the Adriatic ports of Sibenik and Bakar.
Rijeka is the country's biggest sea port.
Croatia has extensive administration requirements for people who want to import goods. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
